problem_text:
A shipping company needs to select packages for a cargo shipment. Available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 25 cubic meters, revenue $218
* Package 2: volume 48 cubic meters, revenue $179
* Package 3: volume 49 cubic meters, revenue $115
* Package 4: volume 45 cubic meters, revenue $137
* Package 5: volume 11 cubic meters, revenue $237
* Package 6: volume 25 cubic meters, revenue $170
* Package 7: volume 29 cubic meters, revenue $283
* Package 8: volume 48 cubic meters, revenue $85
* Package 9: volume 37 cubic meters, revenue $59
* Package 10: volume 48 cubic meters, revenue $154
* Package 11: volume 29 cubic meters, revenue $69
* Package 12: volume 9 cubic meters, revenue $165
* Package 13: volume 35 cubic meters, revenue $137
* Package 14: volume 42 cubic meters, revenue $266
* Package 15: volume 22 cubic meters, revenue $220
* Package 16: volume 37 cubic meters, revenue $181
* Package 17: volume 50 cubic meters, revenue $44
* Package 18: volume 24 cubic meters, revenue $262
* Package 19: volume 1 cubic meter, revenue $67
* Package 20: volume 10 cubic meters, revenue $79
* Package 21: volume 43 cubic meters, revenue $141
* Package 22: volume 18 cubic meters, revenue $75
* Package 23: volume 16 cubic meters, revenue $92
* Package 24: volume 23 cubic meters, revenue $184
* Package 25: volume 44 cubic meters, revenue $266
* Package 26: volume 15 cubic meters, revenue $130
* Package 27: volume 38 cubic meters, revenue $33

The cargo container has a maximum capacity of 574 cubic meters. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
